decisions.sourceZh: 與孟俱行，道遇寇賊，逾年乃至。
decisions.rationale: Current idiomatic drops companion 孟 and the road encounter 道遇寇賊; proposed text restores both propositions. Extraction already links 孟 to p022 Mao Meng via s0018/s0021.

decisions.sourceZh: 李雄遣李驤、任回攻釗，釗自南秦與漢嘉太守王載共距之，戰於溫水，釗敗績，載遂以二郡附雄。
decisions.rationale: Current idiomatic collapses agents into “Xiong’s generals” and omits Zhao’s joint defense with Wang Zai. Proposed repair matches the literal and named persons p013, p040, p009, p028, p023.

decisions.sourceZh: 於是遣治書御史郝嘏為行台，催攝令進討。
decisions.rationale: “Court fired Hao Jia” materially misreads 遣 as dismissal. Proposed wording matches 治書御史…為行台…催攝令進討 (dispatch as mobile headquarters to press the offensive). Literal already correct; extraction p052 consistent.

decisions.sourceZh: 劉胤，字承胤，東萊掖人，漢齊悼惠王肥之後也，美姿容，善自任遇，交結時豪，名著海岱間，士咸慕之。
decisions.rationale: Current idiomatic omits courtesy 字承胤, origin 掖, Qi royal descent, befriending contemporaries, and scholars’ admiration. Proposed repair tracks the sealed literal; minor locution differences only (e.g. Chengyin, Dao-Hui of Qi).

decisions.sourceZh: 且項羽、袁紹非不強也，高祖縞冠，人應如響；
decisions.rationale: Current idiomatic erases 項羽、袁紹 and mislabels 高祖縞冠 as “Liu Bang’s plain cap.” Proposed repair restores the named contrast and Gaozu hemp cap; trailing semicolon preserves continuation into s0092. Extraction p077–p079 aligned.
